extracted_patterns.statement: B2B SaaS ventures with CAC/LTV ratio <0.2 show 2-3x faster growth trajectory than those with ratio >0.5
caveats: Applies primarily to SaaS ventures in growth stage (>6 months post-launch)
Requires sufficient traffic to measure conversion (1000+ visitors/month)
May not apply to land-and-expand models with different unit economics
extracted_patterns.supporting_evidence: 3 ventures with CAC/LTV <0.2 all show 18%+ MoM growth. 2 ventures with ratio >0.5 show <8% MoM growth. Effect size quantified across 8 learning records spanning 8-week observation period.

extracted_patterns.statement: Healthcare software ventures require 3-6 months longer sales cycle than average B2B SaaS, increasing cash burn 40-60%
caveats: Applies to Healthcare IT vendors selling to healthcare providers (not health consumers)
Regulatory requirements (HIPAA) add 3-4 months to procurement
Data from small sample; confidence would increase with more healthcare ventures
extracted_patterns.supporting_evidence: MediLink Connect sales cycle averaging 4-5 months vs 6-8 weeks for DataFlow Analytics. Results in 40-60% higher CAC and extended runway requirements.
counter_examples: Direct-to-consumer health apps may have shorter sales cycles

extracted_patterns.statement: Supply chain software ventures with <5% CAC/LTV ratio and insufficient domain expertise show low conversion (<5%) and high failure risk
caveats: Pattern derived from single venture failure; wider data needed for confirmation
May be specific to direct-to-shipper go-to-market model
Switching costs and competitive entrenchment in logistics higher than other verticals
extracted_patterns.supporting_evidence: TruckRoute Pro conversion 3% vs logistics SaaS industry benchmark 8-12%. Root cause analysis identified lack of domain expertise in team and insufficient understanding of logistics buyer psychology.
counter_examples: Supply chain ventures with strong domain expertise from founding team may succeed

emerging_patterns.pattern_statement: Ventures with >2 key positions unfilled show 2 stage-specific ramp delays vs fully-staffed teams
emerging_patterns.reason_not_published: Only 2 ventures show this pattern; minimum threshold is 3. Will revisit next week as more hiring data arrives.
